$comment: AUTHORITATIVE input contract for the existing K9 clinical engine. Derived by forensic read of backend/protocol-generator.js and backend/server.js in C:/Users/User/k9-rehab-pro. Language-neutral. Any V2 adapter MUST carry every field marked safety_gate true, or the corresponding gate silently fails.

source_of_truth.shape: single flat camelCase object named formData

CRITICAL_call_order_dependency.description: validateIntake() MUTATES formData in place, setting five private severity flags. getExcludedCodes() and selectExercisesForWeek() read those flags. If V2 calls the selection functions without first calling validateIntake on the SAME object reference, the OA / MMT / IVDD / high-pain / Grade-V safety gates silently do not fire.
CRITICAL_call_order_dependency.must_not: pass a copy, a frozen object, or a re-serialized object between the two calls

derived_flags_set_by_validateIntake._highPainOverride: painScore >= 8 -> forces palliative approach plus phase lock
derived_flags_set_by_validateIntake._severeWeakness: mmtGrade <= 1 -> phase lock plus applies full NWB exclusion set
derived_flags_set_by_validateIntake._ivddSevere: ivddGrade IV or V -> phase lock to Phase 1 neuro support
derived_flags_set_by_validateIntake._gradeVSupport: neuroDeepPain contains 'absent' -> passive supportive care only

clientFirstName.validate: one of clientFirstName/clientLastName REQUIRED - hard error if both absent

diagnosis.role: contraindication keyword scan plus protocol type selection

painScore.role: value >= 8 sets _highPainOverride -> palliative plus phase lock

lamenessGrade.role: value >= 5 applies NWB exclusion set when weightBearingStatus is unset

mmtGrade.role: value <= 1 sets _severeWeakness -> passive, NMES and assisted standing only

ivddGrade.role: IV or V sets _ivddSevere -> Phase 1 neuro lock

neuroDeepPain.role: value containing 'absent' sets _gradeVSupport -> passive supportive care only (CRITICAL)

incisionStatus.role: dehisc/infected/open/draining -> HARD ERROR block; otherwise keys INCISION_EXCLUSIONS

complicationsNoted.role: scanned for seroma, dehiscence, implant failure, osteomyelitis, septic keywords

medicalHistory.role: contraindication keyword scan plus complication keyword scan

surgeryDate.role: post-op timing check when treatmentApproach is surgical

aquaticAccess.role: ENABLEMENT gate - aquatic exercises withheld unless true OR modalityUWTM true

route_level_inputs.$comment: Consumed by server.js POST /api/generate-protocol, not by protocol-generator.js. V2 must supply these where it replaces the route.

omission_semantics.description: Omitting an engine input is never neutral. Two distinct failure modes exist and both are clinically wrong.
omission_semantics.fails_unsafe_meaning: The restriction never fires. The patient receives exercises their clinical state forbids.
omission_semantics.fails_restrictive_meaning: Modality and aquatic flags are ENABLEMENT gates, not restrictions. An absent or false flag WITHHOLDS the exercise, removing therapy the clinic can actually deliver.
